value.title: Comincia una nuova vita
value.synopsis: Kasumi va a vivere da sua zia, ma scopre che in realtà la donna ha affittato ad altri tre ragazzi della sua età: un inizio molto in stile Maison Ikkoku!

value.title: Nuovi amici di scuola
value.synopsis: Entra in scena Keiko, "l'altra ragazza", e appena arrivati a scuola Yusaku e Kasumi incappano già nei primi guai!

value.title: La cartolina
value.synopsis: C'è il primo giorno di liceo, e bisogna scegliere il club cui iscriversi: Yusaku è determinato a voler andare nella squadra di tifo, peccato che sia piena di teppisti!

value.title: Il capitano
value.synopsis: Inizia la sottotrama legata al capo del club della squadra del tifo, e la sua amica d'infanzia: il capo chiede un favore a Kasumi mentre Yusaku è malato...

value.title: Il ritorno di Corrado
value.synopsis: Prosegue la storia di Michiko e Sakamoto, cui sembra legata l'eliminazione lo scorso anno del club di baseball dalle manifestazioni.

value.title: Vecchi rancori
value.synopsis: Si conclude la storia di Sakamoto, che nonostante il lieto fine lascia la scuola e il club di tifo. Adesso Yusaku può iscriversi come nuova matricola al club che voleva!

value.title: Una squadra tutta nuova
value.synopsis: Per dare una mano al disastrato club di baseball, Yusaku recluta Ariyama come ricevitore e Mikimoto come terza base (oltre a Keiko come manager per motivare i ragazzi). Pian piano, la squadra si forma

value.title: La gara di salto in alto
value.synopsis: E' arrivato il giorno del torneo di atletica di Kasumi, e Yusaku con il suo club e gli altri ragazzi sono lì a tifarla. Purtroppo un infortunio la mette fuori gioco sul più bello...

value.title: La partita di baseball
value.synopsis: Anche Kasumi è entrata a far parte del club di baseball come manager, e la squadra fa la sua prima partita amichevole per testare le sue potenzialità. Pareggio meritato!

value.title: Lezioni di baseball
value.synopsis: Yusaku è entrato a far parte del club di baseball per sostituire l'esterno centro, infortunato durante l'amichevole. L'allenamento è duro, ma lui ce la mette tutta!

value.title: Il concerto
value.synopsis: Domenica di appuntamenti! Mikimoto invita Ariyama a un doppio appuntamento, e Keiko trova il coraggio di invitare Yusaku a un concerto. Peccato si tratti di musica classica!

value.title: Una lettera per Marina
value.synopsis: Continuano gli allenamenti e Yusaku migliora, nel frattempo Kasumi si prepara perché Katsuhiko sta per venire a trovarla!

value.title: La prima partita delle eliminatorie
value.synopsis: E finalmente iniziano le partite del Koshien! Il primo avversario è subito tosto, ma i nostri si sono allenati parecchio e alla fine vincono!

value.title: Doveri di manager
value.synopsis: Episodio di transizione, il Meiji supera un nuovo avversario nella strada verso il Koshien mentre veniamo a sapere che Katsuhiko arriverà il giorno dopo la finale...

value.title: Una partita difficile
value.synopsis: Yusaku batte la testa durante la partita, e Kasumi si prende cura di lui tutta la notte: episodio molto importante per lo sviluppo del loro rapporto!

value.title: Anche il tifo ha la sua parte
value.synopsis: Puntata interamente dedicata alle semifinali, che nonostante qualche difficoltà vengono brillantemente superate dal Meiji. E adesso manca solo la finale!

value.title: La sorpresa
value.synopsis: E' tempo di giocare la finale, ma una brutta sorpresa attende Yusaku... Katsuhiko-san è arrivato con un giorno di anticipo!

value.title: Forti emozioni
value.synopsis: Katsuhiko si accorge subito dell'attaccamento di Kasumi a Yusaku, perfino durante una finale al cardiopalma. Splendido episodio!

value.title: Il primo bacio
value.synopsis: They lost the final game, but they have no regrets. They have a disappointing party with the usual noodles. However, Katsuhiko also participates there. Katsuhiko is conscious of Yusaku to Kasumi who praises Yusaku.

value.title: Vacanze al mare
value.synopsis: It's summer vacation. The aunt drove to the sea and everybody enjoyed being divided into couples. Suddenly, a girl named Maria, appears in front of Yusaku.

value.title: Una grigliata movimentata
value.synopsis: The aunt invited Shinichiro, who had become close to him at the beach, to a barbecue. His daughter who appeared with him was Maria who tried to kiss Yusaku.

value.title: Il rivale
value.synopsis: Yusaku and the other boarders all went home, and Kasumi was alone with Katsuhiko. However, she is worried about Yusaku.

value.title: Scommettiamo
value.synopsis: Katsuhiko, who declared his rival to Yusaku, "I will propose to Kasumi," has to go back to America. What is Katsuhiko who talks about his passion for baseball?

value.title: Cara Marina
value.synopsis: After returning to America, Katsuhiko recalled the days he spent with Kasumi and his encounter with Yusaku. Kasumi's feelings for her lover are beginning to lean toward Yusaku.

value.title: Una serata in lavanderia
value.synopsis: On Sunday, when the summer vacation is over, Kasumi, who is awakened early in the morning due to the commotion of the housemates, is in a bad mood and collided head-on with Yusaku on the stairs! Why does she get mad?

value.title: L’appuntamento
value.synopsis: Yusaku, who was listening to the late-night broadcast, happened to hear a love call to Kasumi. Is that person the 4th ace they met at the coin laundry?

value.title: L’apparenza inganna
value.synopsis: Kasumi has decided to date the ace no. 4 Takanezawa because of Yusaku who bought the role of Cupid. The shadow of Yusaku at the meeting place!?

value.title: Una notte tempestosa
value.synopsis: After this day a typhoon is coming. Kasumi and Yusaku is now alone in the boarding house. Somehow they become conscious of each other and become awkward.

value.title: Tutti per il baseball
value.synopsis: The baseball team is told by the coach that they will not participate in the autumn tournament. Yusaku of the cheering squad protests directly to the principal! Kasumi also came there. Is Koshien a demon gate?

value.title: Come convincere un direttore
value.synopsis: Members who were told that they could not participate in the official game without the cooperation of the school. They have to do something about it! Yusaku started to move for the baseball club again.

value.title: Il nuovo allenatore
value.synopsis: Yusaku and Kasumi's enthusiasm was transmitted to the school side, the members were gathered again, and the baseball club was appointed as a new coach. A transfer student came to the two classes.

value.title: Un insolito allenamento
value.synopsis: The new coach of the baseball club was Kasumi's lover Katsuhiko. He said he came back from America because he wanted to play baseball, but he also wanted to marry Kasumi.

value.title: Ricomincia il campionato
value.synopsis: Kasumi was upset when Katsuhiko returned to Japan and couldn't concentrate on the practice of the track and field club. Meanwhile, the first round of the baseball club's autumn tournament, the debut match of new coach Katsuhiko has begun.

value.title: Un allenatore all’avanguardia
value.synopsis: Katsuhiko, the new coach returning from America, said he would go to the pool. Members who swim without touching the pole. Why are they swimming when they are in the baseball club?

value.title: Romeo e Giulietta
value.synopsis: The theater festival season has arrived. The theme is "Romeo and Juliet". The protagonists are Yusaku and Kasumi. However, Yusaku suddenly drops off and starts a part-time job.

value.title: La festa di Natale
value.synopsis: Everybody decided to have a Christmas party at Maria's house. Kasumi goes shopping with Yusaku, but Yusaku who broke up on the way does not come back easily.

value.title: Il quiz in tv
value.synopsis: December. Kasumi and the boarders who are supposed to go home have changed their schedule!? Her aunt applied for the high school couple tournament of the quiz show without permission and won the prize.

value.title: La prova di resistenza
value.synopsis: Club competition "cold patience tournament". The representative of the cheering squad is Yusaku, and the baseball club is Ariyama. Every year, they decide to participate in a harsh competition that some people faint.

value.title: La proposta
value.synopsis: After the cold weather tournament, everyone in the boarding house except Kasumi caught a cold. When Kasumi visited Katsuhiko, Maria was there.

value.title: La sfida di kendo
value.synopsis: Yusaku, who is a good friend, was asked by the kendo club, which is said to be the weakest in the prefecture, and decided to participate in the game. It is a promising Yusaku, but there was a formidable newcomer at the partner school.

value.title: Andiamo a sciare?
value.synopsis: Everybody decided to go to a ski lodge run by Mikimoto's uncle. It is said that Ariyama will not go while everyone is excited about skiing.

value.title: Avventura in montagna
value.synopsis: Kasumi together with all the others came to the ski resort. Keiko cares about Ariyama who refrains. Yusaku goes looking for Kasumi who has left alone.

value.title: Una vecchia foto
value.synopsis: Kasumi tells Yusaku that she likes it. She can't tell Katsuhiko, who has been able to talk about anything at the ski resort, and her heart begins to get confused.

value.title: Una partita di allenamento
value.synopsis: "Don't run away from your feelings," says Yusaku from Katsuhiko. On the other hand, Kasumi heard that Katsuhiko refused an unexpected practice match.

value.title: La sfida
value.synopsis: Members who burn in the red and white game in the team. It was a match where they can feel the results of the practice, and the quality of Yusaku was also evaluated. Katsuhiko joined as a pitcher there.

value.title: Una decisione difficile
value.synopsis: It's a serious match between Katsuhiko and Yusaku. Katsuhiko asks "Is it regrettable?" to Yusaku who lost in a splendid strikeout. Isn't Yusaku really wanting to play baseball?

value.title: La lettera
value.synopsis: An express delivery from her mother arrived at Kasumi. The content was that she might transfer to another school due to the circumstances of her parents' home. She is worried about her friends and Yusaku.

value.title: Festa d’addio
value.synopsis: Kasumi decided to transfer to another school. Four of her boarding house friends who lived under the same roof held a bright farewell party. Yusaku, everyone, thank you!
